verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents `fly launch`, run from inside the project source directory, as creating, configuring and (for most apps) deploying a new application, and it has framework-specific docs. That covers the "no manual build configuration" half of the story through automatic setup. However, the workflow is CLI-driven from a local directory rather than connecting a repository, and community reports of frequent deploy failures add caveats. Missing for 10: evidence of repo connection or git push-to-deploy, explicit documentation of build auto-detection (buildpacks or generated Dockerfile), independent confirmation that zero-config deploys work reliably.
